record.paper_title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions
record.original_question: Can a classical de Sitter solution in a classical 10-dimensional string background with a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, D-brane sources, and orientifold sources simultaneously have all four of the following properties: large internal volume, small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds, and quantized fluxes; or is such a combination impossible?

evidence.quote:
Classical 10d string backgrounds with a 4d de Sitter space-time, D-brane and orientifold sources, are commonly believed to satisfy the following:
3. Classical de Sitter solutions cannot have at the same time a large internal volume, a small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds and quantized
fluxes.

artifact.category_tag: Classical de Sitter solutions in string compactifications
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that no classical de Sitter solution can simultaneously enjoy large internal volume, small string coupling, a bounded number of orientifolds, and quantized fluxes remains open. Subsequent work (e.g., Andriot–Ruehle, "On classical de Sitter solutions and parametric control," JHEP 06 (2024) 101) found a scaling that makes the volume parametrically large, providing potential loopholes, but did not establish a controlled counterexample, nor a full proof of the conjecture. The status as of 2024–2025 remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: On classical de Sitter solutions and parametric control
status_evidence.snippet: Previous works concluded that classical de Sitter solutions with parametric control likely do not exist (although loopholes were also indicated). We exhibit an analytic scaling making the overall volume arbitrarily large.
status_evidence.claim: The existence/non-existence of classical de Sitter solutions with simultaneous parametric control remains under active investigation and not settled.

status_evidence.title: Almost classical de Sitter?
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses 'almost classical' de Sitter solutions and the difficulty of achieving full classical control.
status_evidence.claim: The community continues to treat the simultaneous attainment of these four properties as an open problem.
